priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome (WebFetch through the sandbox proxy returned ticker/open-interest/funding data 5-9h stale this run per the freshness guard; browser in-page fetch used throughout for price, candles, open interest, funding, long/short ratio, and liquidation orders instead).
priceSnapshot.note: First session since the Sep 24 midday report (Sep 24 endday never ran, so comparing against midday). Since then, addIf (84,628.2) fired for the first time since the flush -- a settled 1H close at 84,724 (05:00 COT) -- but the breakout fully round-tripped: price printed a marginally higher high (85,258.8, intrabar) then reversed hard to a fresh session low (83,174.7, intrabar only; no settled close broke 83,340.9 or 82,874.5) before stabilizing near 83,940-83,960. Now essentially flat vs. the OKX 24h open (-0.58%).

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 (the flush low, unbroken for three straight sessions) would signal the recovery has fully failed and downside continuation is resuming.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above 85,258.8 (this session's high) would confirm the breakout finally holds, since the prior trigger (84,628.2) already fired once and fully round-tripped.

decisionBox.changed: addIf (84,628.2) fired for the first time this run -- a settled 1H close at 84,724 (05:00 COT Sep 25) -- but it round-tripped completely: a marginally higher high (85,258.8) was rejected and price fell to a fresh session low (83,174.7) before stabilizing. Raising the add trigger to the new session high (85,258.8) since the old one already fired-and-failed once; a re-touch of 84,628.2 alone is no longer sufficient confirmation. reduceIf (82,874.5) remains unbroken for a third straight session. Deploying a small DCA tranche into the spot core here (mid-pullback within an intact daily uptrend) rather than sitting on a passive HOLD.

liquidation.note: ~2.13 BTC notional (~$178.7K) of long liquidations bucketed here over the last ~2h of OKX's realized-liquidation feed (newest fill ~33 min old at fetch time) -- the largest fresh cluster this run, part of the flush that carried price down to the 83,174.7 session low.
~1.62 BTC notional (~$136.0K) of long liquidations, adjacent to and slightly below the 83,500 cluster.
~1.93 BTC notional (~$162.1K) of short liquidations, essentially at the money -- from the earlier bounce toward the failed breakout.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public liquidation-orders API (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled, last 100 fills), fetched fresh via in-page fetch() on okx.com and aggregated into $250 buckets using ctVal=0.01 BTC/contract. Newest fill ~33 min old, oldest ~3h40m old at fetch time -- within the freshness guard.
liquidityMagnet.note: Both sides of the tape got flushed this session (longs at 83,250-83,500 on the reversal down, shorts at 84,000 on the earlier bounce toward the failed breakout) but total volume is modest (~$477K combined) versus prior multi-million-dollar events on this desk -- a quiet, two-sided clearout rather than a one-directional magnet. Slightly more notional sits below spot than above, tilting the immediate pull down.
